# Vitals.com Physician Search & Profile Extractor

Vitals.com is a US physician directory where patients look up doctors by specialty, location or name and read patient ratings. This actor turns those search results and profile pages into structured records with ratings, credentials, insurance and contact details.

## What this actor does

- Searches doctors by any combination of name/keyword, medical specialty (20 curated specialties, from cardiologist to urologist), city and US state — `searchDoctors`, `searchBySpecialty` and `searchByLocation` all run the same underlying search and accept the same filters, so pick whichever name fits your use case
- Fetches specific doctor profiles directly from their Vitals.com profile URLs (`mode=doctorProfile`)
- Empty fields are omitted from records

## Output per doctor

- `doctorId` — Vitals.com internal doctor identifier (when available)
- `name` — doctor's full name
- `specialty` — medical specialty
- `credentials` — degree/credentials, e.g. `MD`, `DO`
- `address`, `city`, `state`, `zipCode` — practice location
- `rating` — patient rating on Vitals.com's scale
- `reviewCount` — number of patient reviews
- `acceptingPatients` — whether the doctor is listed as accepting new patients
- `insurancesAccepted` — insurance plans the doctor is listed as accepting
- `yearsExperience` — years in practice (when published on the profile)
- `languages` — languages spoken (when published on the profile)
- `imageUrl` — profile photo URL
- `profileUrl` — link to the doctor's Vitals.com profile
- `recordType` — always `doctor`
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `searchDoctors` | `searchDoctors`, `doctorProfile`, `searchBySpecialty` or `searchByLocation` |
| `specialty` | string | – (all) | Medical specialty filter |
| `searchQuery` | string | – | Doctor name or keyword (mode=searchDoctors) |
| `city` | string | – | City to search in |
| `state` | string | – (all) | Two-letter US state code |
| `profileUrls` | array | `[]` | Vitals.com doctor profile URLs (mode=doctorProfile) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `20` | Maximum doctor records to return (1–500) |

### Example: search by keyword

```json
{
  "mode": "searchDoctors",
  "searchQuery": "John Smith",
  "state": "NY",
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Example: browse by specialty and city

```json
{
  "mode": "searchBySpecialty",
  "specialty": "cardiologist",
  "city": "New York",
  "state": "NY",
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: fetch specific profiles

```json
{
  "mode": "doctorProfile",
  "profileUrls": [
    "https://www.vitals.com/doctors/dr-john-smith"
  ]
}
```

## Use cases

- **Provider directory building** — assemble a local list of specialists with ratings and contact details
- **Patient-facing research tools** — power a "find a doctor near me" feature with structured data
- **Healthcare market research** — compare provider density and ratings across cities or specialties
- **Insurance network checks** — scan `insurancesAccepted` to find in-network providers
- **Lead generation for healthcare services** — identify practices by specialty and location

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with Vitals.com?** No. This is an independent profile extraction tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Vitals.com.

**Do I need an account to search doctors?** No. Search results and profile pages on Vitals.com are publicly accessible without login.

**What's the difference between `searchDoctors`, `searchBySpecialty` and `searchByLocation`?** None functionally — all three run the same search against whichever of `searchQuery`, `specialty`, `city` and `state` you set. They exist as separate dropdown options for clarity; combine any of those filters regardless of which one you pick.

**Why do some doctors have no `yearsExperience` or `languages`?** Those fields depend on what the doctor or Vitals.com has published on that specific profile; many profiles don't include them.

**Will I always get insurance information?** Only for doctors who list accepted insurance plans on their Vitals.com profile — `insurancesAccepted` is omitted otherwise.

**How current is the rating data?** Ratings and review counts reflect whatever is published on Vitals.com at the time of the run; patient reviews accumulate over time and update on the site independently of this actor.

**Can I look up a doctor directly if I already have their profile URL?** Yes — use `mode=doctorProfile` with `profileUrls` to fetch one or more specific profiles without searching.
